# Setup
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dpi = 300, collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", error = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggrepel)
library(pvclust)

basedir <- here("species/bflo/bulk/KL01")
genomedir <- here("species/bflo/genome/VNyyK")

source(here(basedir, "code/utilities_ggplot.R"), local = TRUE)
```

# Data

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

tpm <- read_tsv(here(basedir, "data/03_compiled/tpm_gut.tsv"))
metadata <- read_tsv(here(basedir, "data/00_metadata/samples_gut.tsv"))

genes <- read_tsv(here(genomedir, "results/genes/gene-display-names.tsv"))
```

# Clustering

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5

pv <- tpm %>% 
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), sqrt)) %>% 
  pvclust(method.hclust = "complete", 
          method.dist = "corr", 
          nboot = 1000, 
          parallel = TRUE)

plot(pv, print.num = FALSE, print.pv = "bp")
```

- There is a clear distinction between hindgut and (midgut + midgut diverticulum), except for `mgut_3`. 
- Within the midgut and midgut diverticulum clusters, the mgut and mdiv samples from the same animal cluster together. i.e. the difference between mgut and mdiv is not more than the variation between the animals; the difference between hgut and mgut + mdiv is clear, however.

# PCA

```{r}
pca_out <- tpm %>% 
  column_to_rownames("gene_id") %>% 
  sqrt() %>% 
  .[which(rowSums(.) > 0), ] %>% 
  t() %>% 
  prcomp(x = ., center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

pc_space <- pca_out$x %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("sample_name") %>% 
  right_join(y = metadata, by = "sample_name") %>% 
  mutate(tissue = factor(tissue, levels = c("mgut", "mdiv", "hgut")))

var_explained <- round(summary(pca_out)$`importance`["Proportion of Variance", ] * 100)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4

ggplot(pc_space, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_polygon(aes(fill = tissue), color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = tissue), color = "black", size = 3, shape = 21) +
  geom_text(data = pc_space, mapping = aes(PC1, PC2, label = rep_id), size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(data = (pc_space %>% 
                      group_by(tissue) %>% 
                      summarize(PC1 = mean(PC1), PC2 = mean(PC2)) %>% 
                      ungroup()),
            aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = tissue)) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", var_explained["PC1"], "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", var_explained["PC2"], "%)")) +
  theme_bw_2()
```

# Comparison with my data from ARCA118

We have a strong batch effect. My samples and KL's samples cluster with other. The tissues don't cluster together across datasets.

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
a118dir <- here("species/bflo/bulk/ARCA118")

tpm_a118 <- read_csv(here(a118dir, "data/03_compiled/tpm.csv"))
md_a118 <- read_csv(here(a118dir, "data/00_metadata/samples.csv"))
```

```{r}
tpm_all <- left_join(tpm_a118, tpm, by = "gene_id")
md_all <- bind_rows(metadata, md_a118)
```

## clustering

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

pv_all <- tpm_all %>% 
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), sqrt)) %>% 
  pvclust(method.hclust = "complete", 
          method.dist = "corr", 
          nboot = 1000, 
          parallel = TRUE)

plot(pv_all, print.num = FALSE, print.pv = "bp")
```


## PCA

- The batch effect is along the PC1 axis
- PC2 goes from div to int, -ve to +ve

```{r}
pca_out_all <- tpm_all %>% 
  column_to_rownames("gene_id") %>% 
  sqrt() %>% 
  .[which(rowSums(.) > 0), ] %>% 
  t() %>% 
  prcomp(x = ., center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

pc_space_all <- pca_out_all$x %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("sample_name") %>% 
  right_join(y = md_all, by = "sample_name") %>% 
  mutate(tissue = factor(tissue, levels = c("mgut", "mdiv", "hgut", "div", "int")))

var_explained <- round(summary(pca_out_all)$`importance`["Proportion of Variance", ] * 100)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5

ggplot(pc_space_all, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_polygon(aes(fill = tissue), color = "black", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = tissue), color = "black", size = 3, shape = 21) +
  geom_text(data = pc_space_all, mapping = aes(PC1, PC2, label = rep_id), size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(data = (pc_space_all %>% 
                      group_by(tissue) %>% 
                      summarize(PC1 = mean(PC1), PC2 = mean(PC2)) %>% 
                      ungroup()),
            aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = tissue)) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", var_explained["PC1"], "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", var_explained["PC2"], "%)")) +
  theme_bw_2()
```
